define_process_with_docker_runtime: define a named process that runs inside a Docker container using mrp.Docker
define_process_with_conda_runtime: define a named process that runs in a Conda environment with specified dependencies and a run command
define_multiple_processes: define multiple named processes with different runtimes in a single msetup.py file
run_mrp_main_cli: run the mrp CLI entry point to start, stop, and manage all defined processes
import_msetup_from_code: import an msetup.py file programmatically to register its process definitions into the current context
